_provenance.note: ATM-Bench full split, 1,013 questions: the frozen 2026-08-21 run (run_id voyage4-deepseek-full-preregistered-final-20260821) rescored on 2026-10-04 with the benchmark's own retrieval evaluator. The figure published and submitted as 'Recall@10 92.8924' is Hit@10, the share of questions with at least one gold item in the top 10: benchmarks/atm_bench.py::metrics_for stores that indicator under the key 'Recall@10'. The board's Recall@10 is the evaluator's recall@10, the mean over questions of |gold & top10| / |gold|, which is 90.0995 here. No retrieval was re-run: the inputs are the run's own retrieval.jsonl, whose hash matches package_sha256 in atm_bench_full_20260821.json, and the released ground truth, whose hash matches data_sha256 there. cross_check recomputes Hit@10 and Recall@10GT from the same inputs and reproduces that artifact's values exactly. The mislabel was found by the board's maintainer reviewing atmbench/atmbench.github.io#3; the board row is corrected by #4.

reproduce: Build a JSON list of {id, gt_evidence_ids, retrieval_ids} from the run's retrieval.jsonl (retrieval_ids as stored) and atm-bench.json (evidence_ids, de-duplicated in order), then from the benchmark repository root run python -m memqa.utils.evaluator.evaluate_retrieval.comprehensive_eval --details <file> --k-values 1,5,10.
